svg.text: Synthetic drift makes the ARKitScenes GT scans able to adjudicate a pose stage (#338)
Absolute GT (3dod_mesh) F@50mm, higher is better. Drift is injected into a copy of the seed poses; the GT mesh is untouched.
A · F@50mm against absolute GT, by injected drift
B · What the pose stage is worth: F(optimize) − F(no pose stage)
Below the line the stage should do nothing; above it, the stage is recovering drift.
C · At heavy drift (d=1), what an outside constraint is for
The plane term recovers drift by associating plane detections across frames through a 0.10 m gate. Past that gate it stops working —
and a loop edge that pulls the seed back inside it is then worth more than either part alone. Where the edges carry 169 mm of their own error (41069048), nothing changes.
Undrifted (d=0) values are the recorded §9.3 rows; drifted variants use seed 1. Drift target = d x 0.20 x trajectory extent.
